description: This source file defines a static class 'RuntimeVersion' that provides a method to retrieve the current version string of the Orleans runtime, including debug or release build information. It also contains a method for checking if an assembly is built in debug mode.

classes.name: RuntimeVersion
classes.description: A static helper class providing runtime version information for Orleans.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the version string of the Orleans runtime, including debug or release info, by inspecting the assembly version and file version.

methods.name: IsAssemblyDebugBuild
methods.description: Determines whether a given assembly was built in debug mode by inspecting its custom attributes.
